data.value: Teko e romela dikopo tsa go buisa fela tse di sa feteng 24, di le nne di dira ka nako e le nngwe. E ema mo metsotswaneng e le 20.

data.name: Text_0184905d7451
data.value: Ke ditiragalo tsa bosheng tse di bolokilweng fela. Ditsebe tsa kgale di go letla go bona hisetori e e leng teng; go simolola tirelo gape go phimola dilogo tsa yone tse di mo memoriring.

data.name: Text_5525724957cc
data.value: Ga go na ditiragalo tse di ka bontshiwang.

data.name: Text_e9556fcfce00
data.value: Tsenya palo e e feletseng ya metsotswana go tloga go 1 go ya go 3,600.

data.name: Text_334776b3cd96
data.value: Tsenya aterese ya HTTPS, kgotsa HTTP mo localhost. O se ka wa akaretsa mafoko a sephiri, ditlhaka tsa dipotso kgotsa dikarolwana.

data.name: Text_53d21e94df96
data.value: Tsenya tokene ya phitlhelelo e e nang le tetla ya status.read go dira teko ya morwalo.

data.name: Text_3b3c9067ffe6
data.value: Tsenya tokene go buisa dipalogotlhe tsa kokoanyo le dilogo tsa tirelo.

data.name: Text_39e9193553c5
data.value: Dikopo di le {0}; dipaletso di le {1}; dikopo di le {2:F1}/motsotswana.

data.name: Text_ead737b6c270
data.value: Tswala o bo o bula phanele gape. Abelana khoutu ya phoso le mofuta wa phoso le ba tshegetso. Tlhola faele ya setifikeiti fa e rulagantswe.

data.name: Text_fec8d8da75de
data.value: Setifikeiti sa HTTPS ga se a kgona go netefadiwa; tokene ga e ise e tlhatlhobiwe. Mo localhost, seta RUNNINGHILL_DASHBOARD_CA_CERT go tsela e e feletseng ya .run/tls/localhost.crt mme o bule desheboto gape. Fa e setilwe, netefatsa gore nginx e dirisa setifikeiti seo le gore leina la moamogedi le matlha a sona di siame. Khoutu ya phoso: HttpRequestError.SecureConnectionError.
